name: Love O2O
description: When campus heartthrob and gaming genius Xiao Nai spots Bei Weiwei dominating a guild battle with unmatched skill and calm, he’s smitten. Determined to win her heart, Xiao Nai pursues her both online and offline, leading to a charming, slow-burn romance between two brilliant minds.

videos.title: Lu Weiwei Gets Dumped
videos.overview: Weiwei, an expert in online games abandoned by her virtual husband Wuxiang is asked by Naihe, a giant in online games, to be his virtual wife.

videos.title: Malicious Gossip
videos.overview: Nai's team is highly appreciated by investors in the mobile game show. Weiwei is ridiculed by Yaoyao's clan and vows to prove her innocence.

videos.title: The New Virtual Wife
videos.overview: Naihe avenges Weiwei, who signs up for an internship with her roommates without knowing that Wuxiang is her new boss's son.

videos.title: Cao Guang Falls In Love
videos.overview: Weiwei impresses Guang. Wuxiang and Yaoyao uses a video to defame Weiwei. Naihe defeats Wuxiang and forces him to delete the video.

videos.title: The In-game Husband
videos.overview: Guang challenges Nai to a basketball duel. Weiwei invites Naihe to participate in a video contest. Nai, the campus prince, sits next to Weiwei and causes a sensation.

videos.title: Approaching Huan Tian Xi Di
videos.overview: Weiwei starts to imagine what Naihe is like in real life. After joining the online game, Guang mistakes Erxi for Weiwei and asks her to be his mentor.

videos.title: You're In Love
videos.overview: Naihe helps Weiwei solve the hardest part of the Couple Task. Weiwei is questioned by the clan and decides to quit, Naihe gives his full support.

videos.title: Naihe Is Missing
videos.overview: Weiwei and her roommates hear Nai has investor problems. Nai is hospitalized by an accident. Weiwei is frustrated when Naihe does not show up.

videos.title: A Wrong Signal
videos.overview: Weiwei realizes she is in love with Naihe. Guang asks Erxi about Weiwei's mood. Naihe invites Weiwei to meet him in real life.

videos.title: First Date
videos.overview: Weiwei meets Naihe and finds out he is Nai. Nai takes Weiwei to his basketball match. Weiwei fears of being misunderstood, but Nai reassures her.

videos.title: The Talk Of The Campus
videos.overview: Nai's interaction with Weiwei causes a sensation in the campus. Weiwei and her roommates take Erxi to hospital. Nai takes the chance to take Weiwei on a date.

videos.title: Xiao Nai's Ambition
videos.overview: Weiwei is impressed by Nai's consideration for female players and his respect for his own game. Weiwei suspects Erxi is having an online love affair. Weiwei and Naihe help with in-game battles.

videos.title: Bribery And Gossip
videos.overview: Naihe helps Wuxiang and Yaoyao. Nai plans to win the right to develop a next generation online game. Yiran shows up to a party and tries to win Nai's attention.

videos.title: Dinner With The Dormmates
videos.overview: Nai rescues Yiran at the party and she mistakes it for attraction. Nai invites Weiwei's roommates to dinner, and runs into Yiran and Nai'er.

videos.title: Xiao Nai Graduates
videos.overview: Guang is angry at Weiwei and Nai. Nai teaches Weiwei to play billiards. Weiwei feels lost when she and Nai are about to be separated for two months.

videos.title: Keeping It As A Secret
videos.overview: Weiwei cares about Nai but fears for the early exposure of their relationship. Weiwei works hard to buy a new phone, Nai goes up against a hacker.

videos.title: A Hacking Competition
videos.overview: Nai defeats and plans to ferret out the hacker. Weiwei gets a new phone and plays a prank on Nai. Weiwei returns to Nai's surprise and he kisses her.

videos.title: The Intern
videos.overview: Nai protects Weiwei from the rain and kisses her again. Nai arranges Weiwei's internship. Weiwei deals with Shuang, who is making things hard for her.

videos.title: Taking Care Of Coffee
videos.overview: Shuang still has prejudice against Weiwei. Erxi works for Guang to repay debts. Weiwei catches cold while helping Shuang, making him feel sorry.

videos.title: Working Under Xiao Nai
videos.overview: Guang fails to woo Weiwei and blames Erxi. Weiwei faints due to illness and Nai cares for her all night. Weiwei can't resist Nai's romantic advance.

videos.title: Erxi Tormented By Yaoyao
videos.overview: Nai teaches Weiwei to swim. After their meeting, Diemeng tells Yaoyao's clan that Weiwei is a beauty. They mistake Erxi for Weiwei and tease her.

videos.title: The Gathering
videos.overview: Erxi takes care of Guang's cat and they grow closer. Weiwei attends a gamer's meeting, Yaoyao's clan try to sow discord but Nai saves Weiwei's face.

videos.title: The Video Clip
videos.overview: Erxi blames Weiwei for her chagrin in the game. Weiwei asks Guang and learns the whole story. Guang apologies to Erxi, but she leaves in sadness.

videos.title: Erxi Wants To Move Out
videos.overview: Knowing that she owes everything to Weiwei, Erxi plans to move out. Nai comforts self-condemned Weiwei. Shaoxiang breaks up with Yaoyao and plans to pursue Weiwei.

videos.title: Cao Guang Confronts Na Na and Yi Ran
videos.overview: Shaoxiang tries to win Weiwei back and vows to defeat Nai. Guang texts Erxi but gets no response, Shuang is threatened by Nai's rival.

videos.title: The Deadline
videos.overview: Nai's team works hard to meet the deadline, Weiwei gives her full support. Yiran hates Weiwei more. Erxi confronts Guang and makes up with Weiwei.

videos.title: An Inspiration
videos.overview: Nai gets inspiration from his date with Weiwei and achieves his optimization goal, but Shuang leaks info to his rival. Nai's parents come to visit.

videos.title: Presentation Of The Game Demo
videos.overview: Weiwei makes up with Yiran. Nai resolves the crisis during the presentation and is highly praised. Shuang is allowed to resign with dignity.

videos.title: Two Years Later
videos.overview: Wuxiang apologies to Weiwei, Nai says he shall await his fair challenge. Two years later, Nai addresses Weiwei as his fiancée in an interview.

videos.title: Obtaining In-law's Approval
videos.overview: Nai proposes to Weiwei publicly in an interview and passes the test of Weiwei's father. They finally get married and live happily ever after.
